text:
maya: Quick — design review for the compact roles panel? dropping a couple screens and questions.

sam: thanks — can you paste the figma link?

maya: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/roleflow-compact - latest frame is ‘collapsed-matrix-v2’. main asks: 1) where should SSO enforcement live in the header vs row overflow, 2) compact row keyboard nav/aria, 3) audit-log deep-link behaviour.

raj: re keyboard/aria: if rows are collapsible we need a single focusable control per row that toggles expansion, not the whole row. NVDA reads repeating table cells badly if we do multiple buttons. suggest `role-toggle` button with `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`.

elena: a11y nit: color contrast on the compact tag (light blue on white) fails AA at 12px. either darken or use a subtle outline. also announce when role assignment changes: "Role X removed from user Y" toast is current but screen reader misses it. consider `role-change` live region.

aisha: copy: "Enforce SSO for this org" feels heavy in the row. shorter: "Require SSO" and move helper copy into a hover tooltip or the right rail.

sam: +1 on shorter copy. also: are we comfortable with the toggle in the global header? org-level enforcement seems more discoverable near org settings, but people expect per-role overrides in the matrix.

maya: that was my dilemma — header toggle would be a global default; per-role override in the row overflow menu. visual affordance: a small lock icon next to role name when overridden.

raj: implementation caveat: showing lock icons on each row increases render cost for large orgs. we should lazy-render icons and only include them in the visible viewport. also pagination vs virtual scroll callout.

elena: keyboard path if we add lock icon needs a label: `aria-label="SSO override: locked for Billing"` so screen readers can read it.

sam: decision proposal: header toggle = global default; row overflow = override; show lock icon only for overridden rows; provide bulk action to apply override to selected rows. agree/disagree?

aisha: agree. add microcopy on bulk modal: "This will enforce SSO for X roles — users without SSO will be removed on next sync." maybe too scary; reword to "Users without SSO will lose access until they enable SSO."

maya: love that wording.

raj: audit-log deep-link: prefer opening a right-drawer showing filtered results (role=X + action=override) instead of navigating away. that keeps context and supports back button. we can append `?drawer=role-audit&role=xyz` to route for deep-linking.

elena: ensure drawer has `aria-modal="false"` and focus is trapped only if interacting with form controls. screen reader should still be able to read background region.

ops-bot: deploy-preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/roleflow/compact-v2 — expires in 48h.

sam: can design mock include keyboard-only walkthrough (tab order) + a short video of NVDA reading core flows? engineers will need that.

maya: will add a 30s screen recording and a keynav spec: tab order, `role-toggle`, overflow menu, bulk select, drawer focus. ETA EOD today.

aisha: one more micro-copy ask: when you hover lock icon show: "Override: requires SSO for this role" (keep concise).

raj: follow-up engineering tasks: 1) aria labels for toggle + lock icon, 2) lazy icon rendering for virtual list, 3) API flag for per-role override and audit filter endpoint. I'll open tickets after review.

sam: cool — I'll mark this as design-approved pending a11y fixes and copy tweaks. thanks all. :tada:
